subject: Running shiny server on Amazon EC2

messages.author: 4e6060fd7b80ee80
messages.subject: Running shiny server on Amazon EC2
parts:
Hey guys:

I am trying to run shiny apps on Amazon EC2. I have already connected to it:

ubuntu@ip-xxx-x-xx:~$ sudo start shiny-server
start: Job is already running: shiny-server

In my local machine, I put my ui.R and server.R files in the directory: /srv/shiny-server/myapp, however, in EC2, I didn't find this folder. So I created it on my own:

ubuntu@ip-xxx-x-xx:~$ sudo mkdir -p /srv/shiny-server/myapps

The problem is, I am unable to change the permission of the files transferred into this directory.

ubuntu@ip-xxx-x-xx:~$ ls -l /home/ubuntu/srv/shiny-server/ec3
total 12
-rw------- 1 root root 1340 Nov 11 14:13 server.R
-rw------- 1 root root 4103 Nov 11 14:13 ui.R

ubuntu@ip-xxx-xx-x-xx:~$ chmod 644 /home/ubuntu/srv/shiny-server/ec3/*

chmod: changing permissions of `/home/ubuntu/srv/shiny-server/ec3/server.R': Operation not permitted
chmod: changing permissions of `/home/ubuntu/srv/shiny-server/ec3/ui.R': Operation not permitted

Anyone can help me on this?

Thank you,

Su
